description: This file defines a React functional component for rendering a preferences menu in a web application. It uses styled-components for styling, React hooks for state handling, and MobX for reactivity. The component displays menu items, handles user interactions, and opens external links based on device environment.

methods.name: PreferencesMenuView
methods.description: React functional component that renders the preferences menu with dropdown and item list, handling user interactions and external link opening.
